update mailbox_messages p set flags=f.flags,modseq=f.modseq
          from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as f(uid bigint,flags text[],modseq bigint)
          where p.mailbox_id=$2::uuid and p.configuration_binding=(select configuration_binding from receiving_mailboxes where mailbox_id=$3::uuid)
            and p.uid_validity=$4::bigint and p.uid=f.uid
            and (($5 and f.modseq is null) or p.modseq is null or (f.modseq is not null and p.modseq<=f.modseq))
            and ($6 or not exists(select from message_commands c where c.mailbox_id=p.mailbox_id and c.source_uid=p.uid and c.source_uid_validity=p.uid_validity
              and c.source_configuration_binding=p.configuration_binding and c.status in ($7,$8) and c.action in ($9,$10,$11,$12)))
